directive.exactGatingQuestion: Normalize XTND post-merger basic and fully diluted shares, S-8/plan overhang, cash runway and financing dependence before any admission or opportunity assessment.
directive.whyItMatters: Capitalization and liquidity must be reconciled without double-counting pre-funded warrants, rollover securities or plan awards before dilution, runway, admission or opportunity conclusions are defensible.
directive.preferredPrimarySource: SEC successor 8-K12B and merger registration/prospectus filings for CIK 0002111860, followed by any post-close S-8 and first post-close periodic report.
lawfulFallbacks: issuer investor-relations filings reproducing filed capitalization tables
directive.successCondition: Primary filings support a reconciled post-close common-share, pre-funded-warrant, option/plan-overhang and cash/runway view with dilution percentages and no double-counting.

evidence.claim: The successor filing reports that the mergers closed September 3, 2026; Xtend holders beneficially owned approximately 87.41% of voting power and 79.61% of economic interests, while JFB holders owned approximately 12.59% and 20.39%, respectively, on a fully diluted basis excluding amounts reserved under the New PubCo equity incentive plan.

Using June 30, 2026 capitalization and zero adjustment amount, the filing expected approximately 253,820,525 New PubCo common shares, 24,872,729 pre-funded-warrant shares, and 36,183,289 shares reserved for New PubCo options; Xtend ordinary shares were expected to convert at approximately 1.36 New PubCo shares each.

The earlier March 31 capitalization case expected approximately 250,571,067 common shares, 11,260,343 pre-funded-warrant shares and 31,140,000 option-reserved shares, demonstrating that the merger capitalization moved materially during the registration process and that an older provisional denominator must not be treated as final.

confirmed: The latest pre-close primary capitalization case located is materially different from the older March 31 case, especially pre-funded warrants and option reserves.
The successor filing explicitly excludes New PubCo equity-incentive-plan reserves from its disclosed fully diluted ownership percentages.
inference: The July S-4/A figures are useful reconciliation anchors but are not sufficient by themselves to assert exact post-close basic shares or exact remaining pre-funded warrants because they are conditional pre-close estimates.

A normalized cash runway cannot be responsibly calculated from the capitalization tables alone; the first post-close balance sheet/cash-flow disclosure or equivalent filed pro forma financial information is required.
remainingExactUnavailableEvidence: Exact post-close common shares outstanding after all closing conversions/issuances.
Exact post-close unexercised pre-funded warrants after beneficial-ownership-blocker substitutions.
Exact current New PubCo incentive-plan reserve/overhang after closing grants and assumed awards.
A post-close cash balance plus normalized operating cash-burn basis sufficient for runway.
analysis.gateImpact: BLOCK admission/opportunity and any normalized dilution/runway conclusion. Do not substitute the July estimated capitalization or the older provisional denominator for final post-close facts.

loopControl.reason: This third directive attempt found a newer primary capitalization anchor and the closing filing but not the exact post-close share/warrant/plan/runway facts required by the success condition. Preserve the missing evidence explicitly and wait for a new primary filing or Chief conservative disposition rather than repeating unchanged searches.
